pages.text: Goggles reach $(l)48$() blocks (Mk I), $(l)160$() (Mk II), $(l)640$() (Mk III) or the whole dimension (Quantum). Signal is full to half the range, gone at the edge; near another's powered Signal Jammer (16 blocks), 30%%. Going back into your body needs over 20%%.
A powered mast passes the link on: head to mast in goggle range, then mast to mast and on to the body within $(l)96$() blocks ($(l)192$() for Mk II). Each mast costs 3%%. It draws 1 FE/t.
